_note: Cue name -> the exact spoken phrase the cue must land on. The builder resolves these to real audio times with tools/word_anchors.py against transcript.json (word-level). Phrases are matched punctuation- and case-insensitive as a contiguous token run; each is unique in narration.txt. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
